subject: Expedite uptime assurance and premium onramp for renewal
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@maplepay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: MaplePay Engineering <engineering@maplepay.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Spike in re-ranker latency — urgent for renewal decision

Hi Grace,

Quick heads up from our side: over the last 10 days we've seen several tail-latency spikes on the Redwood re-ranking endpoint used by checkout. Two incidents (~12 minutes total impact) where 95th/99th latency climbed past our tolerated threshold and caused customer-visible delays. Our ops team attached a short incident log (MAP-incident-log.csv) with timestamps and affected routes.

MaplePay is approaching contract renewal and our executive team is pressuring us to secure stronger uptime guarantees or pause expansion. We want to understand:
- What immediate mitigations can Redwood apply to lower tail latency?
- What commercial paths exist to get enhanced uptime guarantees (short-term pilot vs. premium SLA)?
- How would credits or a remediation plan be structured if incidents recur?

We appreciate your quick attention — can we get a proposal this week? We're aiming to finalize renewal terms by Feb 10.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Platform
MaplePay

Attachments: MAP-incident-log.csv (CSV, 52KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@maplepay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Spike in re-ranker latency — urgent for renewal decision

Hi Emily — thanks for the detailed log and for flagging the renewal timeline. Sorry to hear about the disruption. I looped in Neha and Ben on the commercial path and Markus for an engineering triage.

Short answer: we can provide an accelerated mitigation + a short, timeboxed Premium Onramp (pilot) that gives you a higher SLA and dedicated capacity safeguards while we diagnose root causes. High-level plan below:

Immediate (0-48h):
- Markus to validate routing + batching policy and apply a safe prefix-cache refresh where applicable.
- Temporary request pinning to a lower-latency model variant for the checkout route (if sensitivity tolerates it).

Pilot (30 days):
- Premium Onramp pilot with reserved capacity burst and 99.9% monthly uptime target for the nominated route.
- Instrumented telemetry handoff and weekly quality checks; SLOs agreed on checkout flows.

Commercial / Contract: 
- We can draft an SLA amendment (attached: SLA-amendment-draft.docx) and a short SOW (premium-onramp-plan.pdf) that includes remediation credit language tied to rounded downtime buckets.

Next steps:
1) Markus and Emily (MaplePay Eng) — schedule a technical sync today or tomorrow to agree on mitigations.
2) Neha/Ben — I'll hand to you for a commercial proposal; please include a pilot pricing line and a path to upgrade to standard Premium Tier if pilot performance meets targets.

I attached the premium plan and the incident log you sent (kept local). If that works I can set up an exec touchpoint with Ben next week to finalize direction.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Account Strategy, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

Attachments: premium-onramp-plan.pdf (5 pages), SLA-amendment-draft.docx (editable)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@maplepay.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed commercial terms for Premium Onramp pilot (DEAL-5731)

Emily / team — following Grace's note, here is a concise commercial proposal to enable the pilot and give you formal uptime assurances while we restore confidence ahead of renewal.

Proposal highlights (30-day pilot):
- Reserved capacity: Dedicated reserved pool for checkout re-ranker (sized for current peak + 20% buffer).
- SLA target during pilot: 99.9% monthly uptime on the nominated route; remediation credits scale by 0.5% of monthly committed spend per 30m downtime band beyond SLA, capped at 25%.
- Pilot pricing: incremental $12k/month (pass-through, pro-rated) for reserved capacity + priority support. If pilot succeeds and you elect to upgrade to Premium Tier within 45 days, we'll apply a one-time pilot credit of $9k toward the first month.
- Term and conversion: 30-day pilot -> option to convert to 12-month Premium at pre-negotiated rate; immediate upgrade reduces lead time for dedicated pools.

Operational commitments: weekly sync, a named reliability lead from Redwood, and a shared RCA cadence for any outage.

If that aligns I can prepare a short commercial amendment and DocuSign. Grace — happy to join the exec call you suggested.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: SLA-amendment-draft.docx (version 1, commercial terms added)

From: Emily Park <emily.park@maplepay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: MaplePay Procurement <procurement@maplepay.com>, MaplePay Engineering <engineering@maplepay.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2027 10:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial terms for Premium Onramp pilot (DEAL-5731)

Thanks Ben — the structure looks promising. A few clarifying questions from procurement/ops before we escalate to execs: 
1) Credit math: can you share an explicit example calculation for a 3-hour event in a 30-day pilot? We want to see dollar impact and caps.
2) Data residency & audit: do you have SOC 2 + network boundary evidence for the dedicated pool? Our compliance team needs an evidentiary packet for vendor approval.
3) Timeline: if we greenlight the pilot on Feb 1, when can you guarantee the reserved pool is live and the upgraded routing applied?

Also copying procurement to expedite sign-off. We need the doc set by Friday to firm renewal discussions.

Best,
Emily

Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial terms for Premium Onramp pilot (DEAL-5731)

Emily — appreciate the rapid feedback and copied procurement so we can close the loop. Answers inline: 

1) Credit example: if committed monthly spend = $100k, our remediation credit bands translate to: 30–60m downtime = 0.5% of $100k = $500; 60–90m = 1.0% ($1,000); 3 hours (180m) would hit the third band and, on our scale, issue a 3.0% credit = $3,000, subject to the 25% cap. We'll include a worked example in the formal amendment.

2) Evidence: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; for the dedicated pool we supply network diagram, KMS integration notes, and an audit bundle. Markus — I'll need the compliance packet attached for MaplePay.

3) Timeline: if we sign on Feb 1, technical kickoff same day; reserved pool ready within 96 hours and routing/beta pinning applied within the same 4-day window (we'll target 72 hours).

Next steps:
- Ben to issue DocuSign with the stated pilot pricing and the $9k pilot credit line.
- Markus to attach SOC 2 excerpts + network diagram + incident RCA framework.
- Schedule exec touchpoint for Feb 2 (Grace/Ben + Emily + MaplePay exec sponsor).

I'll prepare a consolidated email with the DocuSign link and the attachments so procurement has everything in one place.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Account Strategy, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
